scope: Design only; no new runtime claim

criteria.clarity: Explicit selected disk and disabled USB installation target; separate destructive review
criteria.convenience: Visible disk list, Back/Next and contextual actions
criteria.usability: Single-select/double-open contract, keyboard alternatives and recovery
criteria.appearance: Original mint/teal composition, consistent surfaces and hierarchy
criteria.readability: Consistent body/secondary/heading sizes; no observed text overlap

review_type: Agent design review, not a human usability study
next_stage_gate: GitHub and anonymous public article/homepage publication required before M11.1
